name: WinterWolfTypeA
identity: Compact shaggy wolf with warm olive-brown upper back, ochre round flank spots, tall triangular pointed brown ears, brown rear crown and cheek ruff, ivory-white angular eyebrows and long centered white muzzle, large ivory-white eye sclera with tiny dark pupils (NOT glowing amber eyes), dark brown oval nose, small ivory fangs, broad white pointed chest/neck ruff, four short brown upper legs with white lower paws, and a full ivory-white bushy curved tail with taupe shaded underside. No collar, armor, dorsal spines or saddle.

source_art_review.method: Viewed complete original atlas and complete serialized source prefab reference; read battle/source hierarchy and anchors.
findings: Tall pointed brown ears, unlike the previous rounded-ear warg.
Ivory eye whites with black pupils; the generic amber-eye description is inaccurate.
Whole tail ivory with taupe underside, not only a white tip.
Brown torso with white shoulder ruff and ochre spots; no dorsal spines.
Four canine legs: fore and hind roots remain attached; Up smooth rear heels and Down toe lines.
source_art_review.attachment_plan: Axial elevated quadruped. Up neck/head at far top, white shoulder ruff below rear head, brown rump below, tail rooted into rump and sweeping down. Down far brown rump above white chest, head overlaps chest below; tail behind far rump. Mirrored leg pairs, opposite diagonal phases, short stride, small torso roll and restrained tail swing.
source_art_review.native_side_contract: Retain all original Wolf float/PPtr curves, head events, controller parameters, lengths and loops; copy and append vertical curves only.
